reasoning: Recent polling in Iowa’s 2026 U.S. Senate race shows a very close contest, with Emerson College/Nexstar giving Ashley Hinson a small lead and other recent polls/aggregators placing the race near toss-up or slightly Republican. Iowa’s statewide Cook PVI is R+6, indicating the state leans Republican structurally even though the current Senate margin is narrow.

sources.name: The Hill / Emerson College Polling / Nexstar Media survey
sources.details: Emerson College/Nexstar found Republican Ashley Hinson leading Democrat Josh Turek 48% to 45% among 712 likely voters.

sources.name: KCCI / Emerson College Polling / Nexstar Media survey
sources.details: KCCI reported the same Emerson poll as a dead heat/very tight race, with Hinson at 47.5% and Turek at 45% among 712 likely voters.

sources.name: Fox News / Beacon Research poll
sources.details: Newsweek reported a Fox News poll showing Democrat Josh Turek ahead of Republican Ashley Hinson 50% to 46% among 1,003 registered Iowa voters.

sources.name: PollsMax Iowa Senate polling average
sources.details: PollsMax's Iowa Senate average shows 44.7% for Turek and 48.2% for Hinson, an R+3.6 average across nine polls.
